messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High GPU queue depth detected on prod (avg queue > 900 for 10m). Autoscaler not reacting. Severity: P1. Paging on-call.

natasha.ops: got page. looking at dashboard. GPU utilization 99% across gpu-pool-a, ingress queue climbing. HPA target metrics show no recent external metric samples.

ryan.sre: seeing increased 429s in traces for heavy-model routes. stack: frontend -> router -> inference-workers. HPA Desired=4 Current=4 for 12m.

natasha.ops: running `kubectl -n prod describe hpa inference-workers`
```
Conditions:
  AbleToScale: False (FailedGetExternalMetric) - error listing external metrics: context deadline exceeded
```

tomo-monitor: prometheus-adapter memory OOMs around 01:03 UTC, restarted by k8s twice. logs: "runtime: out of memory" and "query timed out". Adapter replicas are 1.

hannah-eng: was there a recent deploy that could increase metric cardinality? we did a canary that added request_id label to inference_request_count.

ryan.sre: that label will balloon series. if adapter tries to evaluate a heavy query it can OOM. check prometheus query load.

tomo-monitor: prometheus query log shows many long-running /api/v1/query_range calls for rate(inference_request_count[1m]) grouped by request_id. heavy.

natasha.ops: immediate mitigations: 1) scale inference-workers manually to 16 2) increase prometheus-adapter replicas to 3 3) apply emergency router rate-limit for non-critical customers.

pd-bot: Incident created PD-INC-9901 by natasha.ops — responders: ryan.sre, hannah-eng, tomo-monitor

hannah-eng: executing manual scale now:
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-workers --replicas=16
```

ops-bot: scaled deployment/inference-workers to 16 replicas (by hannah-eng)

ryan.sre: scaling adapter now:
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment prometheus-adapter --replicas=3
```

ops-bot: scaled deployment/prometheus-adapter to 3 replicas (by ryan.sre)

tomo-monitor: adapter pods are up but some show CrashLoopBackOff from OOMKilled. need to restart Prometheus to clear in-flight queries and then restart adapter.

natasha.ops: restarting prometheus (safe restart with leader election)
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart statefulset/prometheus
```

ops-bot: rollout restart initiated for statefulset/prometheus (by natasha.ops)

ryan.sre: applied ingress rule to rate-limit anonymous and non-paying tenants to 5 rps for heavy-model route. Reduced incoming qps by ~40%.

hannah-eng: observed queue drop from ~950 -> ~420 in 6m after manual scale + rate limit. good short-term.

tomo-monitor: prometheus restarted and query backlog cleared. adapter still needs a restart to recover from OOM caches. restarting adapter pods one-by-one.

ops-bot: rolling restart deployed for prometheus-adapter (by ryan.sre)

natasha.ops: adapter external metrics endpoint now returning samples. checking HPA controller.

natasha.ops: `kubectl -n prod get hpa inference-workers -o jsonpath='{.status}'` -> shows desiredReplicas: 18; autoscaler recommended scaling up and will then stabilize.

ryan.sre: good. autoscaler is picking up external metrics again. we should leave manual replicas until load normalizes to avoid oscillation.

hannah-eng: customer impact note: some customers saw elevated latency (10-30s) and 15% error rates on heavy-model endpoints for ~50 minutes. Notifying CSMs. No data breach.

pd-bot: PD-INC-9901 status: MITIGATED -> triage in progress. assigned to ryan.sre for RCA.

tomo-monitor: root cause hypothesis: a config change added high-cardinality label to a high-frequency metric (inference_request_count{request_id}) which caused Prometheus query amplification. prometheus-adapter on single replica attempted heavy queries, OOM'd, and external metrics became unavailable causing HPA to stop scaling. Secondary factor: adapter replica count of 1 and low resource limits.

ryan.sre: next steps (action items):
- RCA doc (ryan.sre)
- revert request_id label on the high-volume metric or switch to label_relabel_configs to drop high-cardinality label (hannah-eng)
- increase adapter replicas & memory in manifest (ryan.sre)
- add alert for adapter OOM and prometheus query-duration > 5s
- add HPA fallback alert when AbleToScale=False for > 2m (natasha.ops)
- runbook: emergency manual scaling + traffic throttling steps (natasha.ops)

hannah-eng: will push a fix to instrumentations to remove request_id from inference_request_count and deploy to canary then prod.

natasha.ops: handing off monitoring to night-oncall at 05:00 UTC. leaving watches for 90m.

ryan.sre: marked incident as mitigated at 03:40 UTC — system autoscaling resumed and error rates trending down. will draft full RCA later today.

incident-bot: INCIDENT PD-INC-9901 - MITIGATED by ryan.sre at 03:40 UTC. Severity downgraded to P2.

hannah-eng: final note: avoid adding high-cardinality labels to metrics that feed autoscaling. Use tracing/id logs instead.

natasha.ops: thanks team. closing thread and tracking action items in Jira.
